mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (11286, 21620) and has to end up at (10937, -3577). On the way it must stop at A (Plaistows Airfield) at (-9011, 25371), B (Denham Aerodrome) at (-18209, 9818), C (London Heliport) at (4877, -3345), D (Ascot Racecourse Heliport) at (-28367, -8718); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [RAF Northolt (EGWU, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [London Heathrow Airport (EGLL, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [London City Airport (EGLC, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [London Biggin Hill Airport (EGKB, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 155398 meters. The battery only allows 162498 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Dysons Osiers Airstrip; DEST is King's College Hospital Helipad.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
